name: asva-desktop
description: ASVA - reads Tally, sends bills and reminders on the shop's own WhatsApp.

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Smoother updates: fixed the "ASVA cannot be closed" message that could pop up while updating. ASVA now closes its background parts on its own and installs the update quietly, so you no longer have to close anything by hand.

Also in recent updates: a cleaner, sturdier Today screen - Who to chase shows each customer's phone number with one-tap Call next to Remind; add a missing number right on Today for the customers who owe you but have no WhatsApp; honest counts (only customers who OWE you and have no number, never every party); do-not-chase customers stay off the chase list; opening a payment no longer leaves Today stuck on another page; and the page recovers on its own instead of going blank. Plus trade-based due dates (electricals 60 days) when Tally has none, a fairer reliability score where one late bill among many paid does not drag a customer down, a money-in alert when a customer says they paid, your WhatsApp login surviving updates, and a one-tap 'confirm your balance' you can send at most once every 90 days.
